pairs.target: dōng wū de chuāng kāi dé gāo , guāng luò zài zhuōshàng , xiàng yíkuài xǐ dé fābái de bù .

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dào shí , dé mǎ yǐjīng bǎ xiùkǒu zhā hǎo le .

pairs.hanzi: 塔维到时，德玛已经把袖口扎好了。

pairs.target: luò héng zhè yìzǔ pái zài xiàwǔ , tā biàn tóngtǎ wéi dādàng .

pairs.hanzi: 洛衡这一组排在下午，她便同塔维搭档。

pairs.target: tā bǎ jìlùzhǐ zhuǎngěi tā kàn , wèn tā xiǎng xiān dòngshǒu háishì xiān jì .

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō dōuxíng , tā jiù bǎ bǐ sāi gěi tā , zìjǐ zuò dào jiājù qián .
pairs.english: Tavi said either was fine, so she pressed the pen into his hand and sat at the fixture herself.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说都行，她就把笔塞给他，自己坐到夹具前。

pairs.target: zhèxiē tiěpiàn láizì lìngyìzhī qìcái xiāng ,

pairs.hanzi: 这些铁片来自另一只器材箱，

pairs.english: Instructor Vey checked their dimensions and weights in front of them, then performed a contact demonstration first.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师当着他们的面核过尺寸和配重，先做了一次接触示范。

pairs.target: ménwài tiēzhe jiǎnchá rìqī , wūzi de jīchǔ yǔ běi yì jiù gòujià fēnkāi , hòuxù guānchá réng yǒurén fùzé .
pairs.english: The inspection date was posted outside; the room's foundation was separate from the north wing's old framework, with continued monitoring assigned.
pairs.hanzi: 门外贴着检查日期，屋子的基础与北翼旧构架分开，后续观察仍有人负责。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kàn le nà zhāng zhǐ liǎngbiàn , què zǒng xiǎngqǐ nàwǎn de tiě huáng , méiyǒu shuí pèng , tā yě wǎng xià wān .
pairs.english: Tavi read that paper twice, yet kept remembering the spring that night: nobody had touched it, and it had bent downward anyway.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看了那张纸两遍，却总想起那晚的铁簧，没有谁碰，它也往下弯。

pairs.target: dé mǎ de dìyīcì méiyǒu chūcuò .
pairs.english: Dema's first attempt went without error.
pairs.hanzi: 德玛的第一次没有出错。

pairs.target: tā ràng yìbiān shāoshāo xiàyí , zài lǎoshī diǎntóu yǐqián biàn tíng le , shuō yòushǒu de wèizhì bù shūfú .
pairs.english: She made one side sink slightly, then stopped before the instructor nodded, saying her right hand was awkwardly placed.
pairs.hanzi: 她让一边稍稍下移，在老师点头以前便停了，说右手的位置不舒服。

pairs.target: sōngkāi hòu , liǎngbiān huīfù . tǎ wéi dītóu jìxià , hái méi xiě wán , tā jiù wèn néng bunéng bǎ " tíng le " xiě qīngchǔ , bié zhī huà yìtiáo duǎn héng .
pairs.english: Both sides returned after she released them. Tavi bent over his record, but before he finished she asked him to write “stopped” clearly rather than just a short dash.
pairs.hanzi: 松开后，两边恢复。塔维低头记下，还没写完，她就问能不能把“停了”写清楚，别只画一条短横。

pairs.target: " wǒ búshì méi zuò chūlái . " tǎ wéi shuō zhīdào , tiān le liǎnggè zì .
pairs.english: “It's not that I couldn't do it.” Tavi said he knew and added two characters.
pairs.hanzi:
“我不是没做出来。”
塔维说知道，添了两个字。

pairs.target: tā còujìn kàn , mǎnyì dì zuò huíqù , jiǎo zài dèngzǐ xiàmiàn qīngqīng yáo .
pairs.english: She leaned closer to look, then sat back contentedly, her feet gently swinging beneath the stool.
pairs.hanzi: 她凑近看，满意地坐回去，脚在凳子下面轻轻摇。

pairs.target: lún dào tā shí , zhuōmiànshàng yǒu yídào qiǎnqiǎnde shuǐyìn , shì fāngcái cā shǒu liúxià de .
pairs.english: When his turn came, a faint water mark remained on the table from drying their hands.
pairs.hanzi: 轮到他时，桌面上有一道浅浅的水印，是方才擦手留下的。

pairs.target: tā ná bù zài cā yícì , bǎ bù zhé hǎo , yòu bǎ yǐzi wǎng lǐ nuó .
pairs.english: He wiped it again, folded the cloth, then moved his chair farther in.
pairs.hanzi: 他拿布再擦一次，把布折好，又把椅子往里挪。

pairs.target: dé mǎ děng zhe , bǐjiān xuán zài zhǐ shàng . wéi lǎoshī zài pángbiān nà zhuō jiūzhèng yìzhī jiājù , méiyǒu cuī tā .
pairs.english: Dema waited with her pen poised over the paper. Instructor Vey was correcting a fixture at the next table and did not hurry him.
pairs.hanzi: 德玛等着，笔尖悬在纸上。维老师在旁边那桌纠正一只夹具，没有催他。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi de shǒu shēnchū qù , dào tiěpiàn shàngfāng yòu tíngzhù .
pairs.english: Tavi reached out, then stopped with his hands above the iron strips.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维的手伸出去，到铁片上方又停住。

pairs.target: tā xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ hǎn lǎoshī de shēngyīn , xiǎngqǐ rénqún hūrán ānjìngxiàlái .
pairs.english: He remembered his voice calling the instructor and the crowd suddenly falling silent.
pairs.hanzi: 他想起自己喊老师的声音，想起人群忽然安静下来。

pairs.target: nàshí hàipà de shì méi rén zhīdào fāshēng le shénme , xiànzài suǒyǒu dōngxī dōu bǎihǎo le , tā què liánpèng yě méi pèng .
pairs.english: Then he had feared that nobody knew what was happening. Now everything was ready, yet he had not even touched it.
pairs.hanzi: 那时害怕的是没人知道发生了什么，现在所有东西都摆好了，他却连碰也没碰。

pairs.target: " nǐ yào wǒ xiān bǎ zhǐ yíkāi ma ? " dé mǎ wèn .
pairs.english: “Do you want me to move the paper out of the way first?” Dema asked.
pairs.hanzi: “你要我先把纸移开吗？”德玛问。

alignment.english: move the paper out of the way

pairs.target: tā yáotóu . zhǐ méiyǒu dǎnglù . tā bǎshǒu fàng huí xī shàng , shuō děng yíxià .
pairs.english: He shook his head. The paper was not in the way. He put his hands back on his knees and said to wait a moment.
pairs.hanzi: 他摇头。纸没有挡路。他把手放回膝上，说等一下。

pairs.target: dé mǎ bǎ bǐ gēxià , méiyǒu xiě . tǎ wéi dīng zhe tā nà zhāng kōng zhe de jìlùzhǐ , fǎndǎo gèng nánshòu ,
pairs.english: Dema set down the pen without writing. Staring at her blank record sheet made Tavi feel worse instead.
pairs.hanzi: 德玛把笔搁下，没有写。塔维盯着她那张空着的记录纸，反倒更难受，

pairs.target: wèn tā shìbushì cóngláibú pà . tā kànzhe tā , xiàng zài xiǎng zhèhuà cóng nǎlǐ lái .
pairs.english: He asked whether she was never afraid. She looked at him as though wondering where the question had come from.
pairs.hanzi:
问她是不是从来不怕。
她看着他，像在想这话从哪里来。

pairs.target: " nàwǎn wǒ zài ménwài . " tā shuō , " wǒ pà jǐ bù chūqù , hòulái cái zhīdào lǐmiàn zěnme le . nǐ wèn de shì nǎ yìzhǒng ? "
pairs.english: “I was outside the door that night,” she said. “I was afraid I couldn't get out of the crowd. Only later did I learn what happened inside. Which kind do you mean?”
pairs.hanzi: “那晚我在门外。”她说，“我怕挤不出去，后来才知道里面怎么了。你问的是哪一种？”

alignment.english: couldn't get out of the crowd

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō zìjǐ bù zhīdào . tā bǎ jiǎo tíngzhù , shuō tā xiànzài pà dào le xiàcì fēnzǔ hái zhǐnéng jìshù ,
pairs.english: Tavi said he didn't know. She stopped swinging her feet and said she now feared still being only the recorder at the next grouping.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说自己不知道。她把脚停住，说她现在怕到了下次分组还只能记数，

pairs.english: Her family kept asking what she had learned; she did not want to reply that she had only learned to wait.
pairs.hanzi: 家里总问学会什么了，她不想回信只说学会等。

pairs.english: Then, feeling she had been too harsh, she added that she was not telling him to hurry.
pairs.hanzi: 说完又觉得太狠，添了一句，不是叫他赶快。

pairs.target: " wǒ zhīdào . " tǎ wéi shuō . zhècì tā zhēn zhīdào .
pairs.english: “I know,” Tavi said. This time he truly did.
pairs.hanzi: “我知道。”塔维说。这次他真知道。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī guòlái , tā gàosù tā shǒu hái méi pèngshàng , xīntiào jiù hěnkuài .

pairs.hanzi: 维老师过来，他告诉她手还没碰上，心跳就很快。

pairs.target: tā méi bǎ zhè suàn chéng cāozuò shībài , zhī ràng tā xiān kàn dé mǎ zài zuò yìlún .
pairs.english: She did not count this as a failed attempt, only asked him to watch Dema take another turn.
pairs.hanzi: 她没把这算成操作失败，只让他先看德玛再做一轮。

pairs.target: tā zhàn zài cèmiàn , yǎnjīng gēnzhe tiěpiàn mòduān zǒu .
pairs.english: He stood to one side, following the tips of the strips with his eyes.
pairs.hanzi: 他站在侧面，眼睛跟着铁片末端走。

pairs.target: dòngzuò hěnxiǎo , pángbiān nà zhāng zhǐ méiyǒu dǒu , dé mǎ sōngshǒu yǐhòu , hái tèyì bǎ liǎngshǒu tān gěi tā kàn .
pairs.english: The movement was tiny; the paper beside it did not tremble. After releasing the strips, Dema deliberately spread both hands for him to see.
pairs.hanzi: 动作很小，旁边那张纸没有抖，德玛松手以后，还特意把两手摊给他看。

pairs.target: tā xiào le yíxià , tā yě xiào , shuō búshì gěi tā jiǎnchá zìjǐ yǒuméiyǒu tōu cáng yípiàn tiě .
pairs.english: He smiled, and she smiled too, saying it was not so he could check whether she had hidden an iron strip.
pairs.hanzi: 他笑了一下，她也笑，说不是给他检查自己有没有偷藏一片铁。

pairs.target: zài zuòxià shí , tǎ wéi xiān bǎ shǒuzhǎng fàngzài zhuō yán , děng hūxī mànxiē , cái yí dào liǎngchù jiēchùmiàn shàng .

pairs.hanzi: 金属凉，凉得很普通。

pairs.target: tā fēnqīng liǎngbiān de qiānchě , méiyǒu qù zhuī gèng dà de biànhuà .
pairs.english: He distinguished the pull on each side without chasing a larger change.
pairs.hanzi: 他分清两边的牵扯，没有去追更大的变化。

pairs.target: zuǒbiān yí guòbàn dào kèxiàn , tā biàn jiéshù , ràng mòduān huílái .
pairs.english: When the left side moved half a scale division, he ended it and let the tip return.
pairs.hanzi: 左边移过半道刻线，他便结束，让末端回来。

pairs.target: dé mǎ wèn zhèhuí zěnme jì . tā shuō àn tā kànjiàn de jì , biétì tā tiān yígè wěn zì .
pairs.english: Dema asked how to record this one. He told her to record what she saw, not add the word “steady” for his sake.
pairs.hanzi: 德玛问这回怎么记。他说按她看见的记，别替他添一个稳字。

pairs.target: tā yáng le yángméi , dītóu xiě le yìháng , mòwěi de zì jǐ dào le biānshàng .
pairs.english: She raised her eyebrows and bent to write a line, squeezing its last character against the edge.
pairs.hanzi: 她扬了扬眉，低头写了一行，末尾的字挤到了边上。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī wèn hái zuò bu zuò .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey asked whether he wanted another try.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师问还做不做。

pairs.target: tā běn xiǎng zài lái yícì , zhèngmíng zìjǐ yǐjīng méishì , chūkǒu quèshuō jīntiān gòu le .
pairs.english: He wanted one more attempt to prove he was fine now, but instead said it was enough for today.
pairs.hanzi: 他本想再来一次，证明自己已经没事，出口却说今天够了。

pairs.target: tā ràng tā shōu jìlù , méi dāngzhe biérén kuā tā , yě méiyǒu bǎ dé mǎ shèngxià de yìlún qǔxiāo .
pairs.english: She told him to gather his record, without praising him in front of everyone or canceling Dema's remaining turn.
pairs.hanzi: 她让他收记录，没当着别人夸他，也没有把德玛剩下的一轮取消。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tì tā fú hǎo zhǐ , kàn wán cái yìqǐ líkāi .
pairs.english: Tavi steadied the paper for her, watched her finish, and then they left together.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维替她扶好纸，看完才一起离开。

pairs.target: ménkǒu pèngjiàn yīwén bào zhe gē běn děng huànwū , tā wèn tǎ wéi zěnyàng .
pairs.english: At the door they met Iven holding songbooks, waiting for the room change. He asked Tavi how it had gone.
pairs.hanzi: 门口碰见伊文抱着歌本等换屋，他问塔维怎样。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō zuò le yícì , yīwén shuō nà wǎnshàng chīfàn zài jiǎng , lǐmiàn de rén yǐjīng zài jiào tā lǐng yīn .
pairs.english: Tavi said he had done it once. Iven said to tell him over supper; people inside were already calling him to lead the singing.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说做了一次，伊文说那晚上吃饭再讲，里面的人已经在叫他领音。

pairs.target: wǎnfàn qián , tǎ wéi qù le nài lěi jièzhù de yuànzi .
pairs.english: Before supper Tavi went to the courtyard where Nerai was lodging.
pairs.hanzi: 晚饭前，塔维去了奈蕾借住的院子。

pairs.target: tā zhèngzài xǐ yìshuāng quán shì ní de xié , kànjiàn tā xiān wèn zuówǎn shuìzháo méiyǒu .
pairs.english: She was washing a pair of muddy shoes and, seeing him, first asked whether he had slept last night.
pairs.hanzi: 她正在洗一双全是泥的鞋，看见他先问昨晚睡着没有。

pairs.target: tā shuō shuìzháo le , yòu bǎ jīntiān de shì jiǎngwán , cái cóng yīdài lǐ náchū xiě zhe yú wān de zhǐ .
pairs.english: He said he had, then told her about today before taking the paper marked Elmbay from his pocket.
pairs.hanzi: 他说睡着了，又把今天的事讲完，才从衣袋里拿出写着榆湾的纸。

pairs.target: tā wèn néng bunéng zhǎo gè zhīdào nàlǐ xiànzài jiào shénme de rén .
pairs.english: He asked whether they could find someone who knew what the place was called now.
pairs.hanzi: 他问能不能找个知道那里现在叫什么的人。

pairs.target: nài lěi cāgān shǒu , kàn le zhōushīfu nàtiáo zhùmíng lái chù de jìzǎi ,
pairs.english: Nerai dried her hands and read Master Zhou's account with its source annotation.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾擦干手，看了周师傅那条注明来处的记载，

pairs.target: shuō hòutiān huòzhàn yǒu gè cháng zǒu xiàhé yóulù de rén huílái .
pairs.english: She said someone who regularly traveled the downriver mail route would return to the freight station the day after tomorrow.
pairs.hanzi: 说后天货站有个常走下河邮路的人回来。

pairs.target: tā běnlái jiùyào qù jiāo yífèn tú , kěyǐ dài tā wèn , dàn nàge rén bú rènshi dāngnián de chāi chēgōng .
pairs.english: She already had to deliver a map there and could take him to ask, but the person did not know the old dismantling crew.
pairs.hanzi: 她本来就要去交一份图，可以带他问，但那个人不认识当年的拆车工。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō xiān wèn dìfāng jiù hǎo . nài lěi bǎ zhǐ háigěi tā , jiào tā bǎ yào wèn de xiě zài bèimiàn .
pairs.english: Tavi said asking about the place was enough for now. Nerai returned the paper and told him to write his questions on the back.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说先问地方就好。奈蕾把纸还给他，叫他把要问的写在背面。

pairs.target: fēngchuī dé yuànlǐ shī xiédài yíxiàyixià pèng qiáng ,
pairs.english: The wind made wet shoelaces tap against the courtyard wall.
pairs.hanzi: 风吹得院里湿鞋带一下一下碰墙，

pairs.target: tā dūnxiàlái bāng tā nǐng lìngyìzhī xié , zhídào zhǐfèng lǐ liúchū de shuǐ búzài nàme hēi .
pairs.english: He crouched to help wring out the other shoe until the water running between his fingers was no longer so black.
pairs.hanzi: 他蹲下来帮她拧另一只鞋，直到指缝里流出的水不再那么黑。
